behaviorChanges: claude-review is now available on the stable release line as the sanctioned Codex-to-Claude Stage 2 launcher
claude-review packet preflight rejects incomplete Git-backed review packets before invoking Claude
claude-review-status summarizes recent clean, blocked, degraded, timeout, parse-error, packet-preflight, and transport-failure artifacts
claude-review records a structured claude_transport_failure for nonzero Claude CLI exits
Claude CLI signal exits such as 143 include signal metadata and an explicit recovery next action
failed Claude transport runs do not write review_result and return a transport-failure exit code, normalizing direct signal returns to 128+signal
rollbackNotes: Revert to 0.6.127 if downstream tooling cannot tolerate the new claude-review command or additional claude_transport_failure artifact field.
No adapter rollback is required because no adapter schema or generated adapter behavior changed.
